query: Can Grafana MCP keep working all day with my human login and renew without exposing the token?
expected_behavior: Explain observation-based scheduling and its lack of authoritative token expiry.
Describe the one-hour reuse, ten-hour renewal and eleven-hour operational cap.
Repeated token bytes do not extend their observation time.
Rotation requires reconnecting; do not promise uninterrupted operation or indefinite human renewal.
